paper: APPSC Junior Lecturers in Government Junior Colleges (Notification No. 22/2018) Screening Test - General Studies & Mental Ability, held 17-02-2020 (Session 1)

questions.s: Pearl Harbor is a US naval base near Honolulu, Hawaii, that was the scene of a devastating surprise attack on 7 December 1941. Name the country that attacked Pearl Harbor.
questions.x: Imperial Japan attacked Pearl Harbor on 7 December 1941, which brought the USA into the Second World War.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: What was the rivalry between the US and the Soviet Union called that lasted for decades and resulted in anti-communist suspicions and international incidents that led the two superpowers to the brink of nuclear disaster?
questions.x: The long post-1945 rivalry between the USA and the USSR is called the Cold War.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: What was the codename of the operation that was launched in 1984 to drive out the Sikh extremist religious leader Jarnail Singh Bhindranwale and his armed followers from the premises of the Golden Temple in Amritsar?
questions.x: Operation Blue Star (June 1984) was the army action to remove Bhindranwale and his followers from the Golden Temple.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: What was the theme of the first 'International Day of the Girl Child' that was observed on 11 October 2012?
o: Empowering Adolescent Girls: Ending the Cycle of Violence
The Power of the Adolescent Girl: Vision for 2030
questions.x: The first International Day of the Girl Child (2012) had the theme 'Ending Child Marriage'.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: 7th December is observed as ______.
questions.x: International Civil Aviation Day is observed on 7 December, the anniversary of the 1944 Chicago Convention.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Which of the following began in 1845 when a fungus-like organism called Phytophthora infestans spread rapidly throughout Ireland?
questions.x: Potato blight caused by Phytophthora infestans led to the Irish Potato Famine of 1845-1849.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: On 16 January 1991, President George HW Bush made an announcement about a military operation called ______ to expel occupying Iraqi forces from Kuwait, which Iraq had invaded and annexed months earlier.
questions.x: Operation Desert Storm (1991) was the US-led coalition campaign to drive Iraq out of Kuwait.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Titanic had its own newspaper, which was printed every day and included news, stock prices and horseracing results, as well as the day's menu. What was the name of the newspaper?
questions.x: The Titanic printed the 'Atlantic Daily Bulletin' on board every day.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: During the ______ Gandhi and his lawyers travelled to different villages, meeting farmers and taking note of their sufferings and complaints against the forced indigo cultivation.
questions.x: In the Champaran Satyagraha (1917), Gandhi recorded the complaints of indigo farmers in Bihar.
questions.subject: History

questions.s: Which two Indian cities are among the 66 urban settlements designated as creative cities by the United Nations Educational, Scientific and Cultural Organization (UNESCO)?
questions.x: In 2019 UNESCO named Mumbai (film) and Hyderabad (gastronomy) among 66 new Creative Cities.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which cricketer became the first Indian to hit 400 international sixes?
questions.x: Rohit Sharma became the first Indian to hit 400 international sixes, in December 2019.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which Pakistani political figure was sentenced to death by the Pakistan court in December 2019 for high treason?
questions.x: A special court sentenced former President Pervez Musharraf to death for high treason in December 2019.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which supersonic cruise missile was successfully test-fired from a base in Odisha's Chandipur on 17 December 2019?
questions.x: The BrahMos supersonic cruise missile was test-fired from Chandipur on 17 December 2019.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which Hindi film was officially selected for screening at the 11th edition of the 'WIND International Film Festival' that was held in December 2019?
questions.x: The Hindi film 'Antardhwani - The Inner Voice' was selected for the WIND International Film Festival in 2019.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: In the year 2019, 16-year-old activist ______ became the youngest individual ever to be named 'Time's Person of the Year'.
questions.x: Greta Thunberg, aged 16, was named Time's Person of the Year 2019, the youngest ever.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: In December 2019, at the age of 34, Sanna Marin became the world's youngest prime minister of the country ______.
questions.x: Sanna Marin became Prime Minister of Finland in December 2019 at the age of 34.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following contestants was crowned 'Miss Universe 2019'?
questions.x: Zozibini Tunzi of South Africa was crowned Miss Universe 2019.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: In November 2019, ______ became the first country in the world to introduce the World Health Organization (WHO) recommended typhoid conjugate vaccine (TCV) into its national immunisation programme.
questions.x: In November 2019 Pakistan became the first country to add the WHO-recommended typhoid conjugate vaccine to routine immunisation.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which city was selected as the 'World's leading Sports Tourism Destination' at the 26th edition of the World Travel Awards (WTA) held in Muscat in December 2019?
questions.x: Abu Dhabi was named World's Leading Sports Tourism Destination at the 2019 World Travel Awards.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Who was the Chief Guest at the Republic Day 2020 celebrations in India?
questions.x: Brazilian President Jair Bolsonaro was the chief guest at Republic Day 2020.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: In December 2019, UNESCO added 'Nuad Thai' to its list of "Intangible Cultural Heritage" practices. What is Nuad Thai?
questions.x: Nuad Thai, traditional Thai massage, was added to UNESCO's Intangible Cultural Heritage list in December 2019.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Name the famous US climber who fell to his death while rappelling in Mexico in November 2019.
questions.x: US climber Brad Gobright died in a rappelling accident at El Potrero Chico, Mexico, in November 2019.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which language was used in Rajya Sabha for the first time in the recent winter session of Parliament in December 2019?
questions.x: Santhali was spoken in the Rajya Sabha for the first time, by MP Sarojini Hembram, during the 2019 winter session.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: In December 2019, Shashi Tharoor won the 'Sahitya Akademi Award' for his book ______.
questions.x: Shashi Tharoor won the 2019 Sahitya Akademi Award (English) for 'An Era of Darkness'.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following awards has NOT been won by Australian cricket all-rounder Ellyse Perry?
o: ICC Women's ODI Player of the Year 2019
ICC Women's Emerging Player of the Year 2019
questions.x: Perry won the 2019 ODI Player award and the Rachael Heyhoe-Flint Award in 2017 and 2019; the Emerging Player award is for young players and she did not win it.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following institutions launched India's first indigenously designed standing wheelchair called 'Arise'?
questions.x: IIT Madras developed 'Arise', India's first indigenous standing wheelchair, in 2019.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which was the first UN organisation to start accepting crypto currency donations?
questions.x: In October 2019 UNICEF launched a CryptoFund, the first UN body to take donations in cryptocurrency.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: The Telangana government will celebrate 2020 as the year of ______ to promote its use in various sectors such as agriculture, urban transportation and healthcare.
questions.x: Telangana declared 2020 the 'Year of Artificial Intelligence'.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: What is the name of the unique bar-coding software adopted by Haryana Police to ensure that thousands of forensic reports that form the backbone of the criminal investigation system and subsequent trials in the courts of law are not tampered with?
questions.x: Haryana Police adopted 'Trakea', a bar-coding software that protects forensic reports from tampering.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Name the vulnerability in Android devices that caught the eye of the cybersecurity wing of India's Ministry of Home Affairs in December 2019.
questions.x: In December 2019 MHA's cyber wing warned about 'StrandHogg', an Android flaw that lets malware pose as genuine apps.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: What is the name of the experimental and educational space satellite developed by high school students of Israel which was launched by ISRO's PSLV-C48?
questions.x: Duchifat-3, built by Israeli high-school students, was launched on PSLV-C48 in December 2019.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: The government of India is testing a prototype of an Indian equivalent of popular messaging platforms, such as WhatsApp and Telegram, for secure internal use. What is the name of this platform?
questions.x: The government's own secure messaging app is called GIMS (Government Instant Messaging System).
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following is an Earth observation spy satellite developed by India's space agency ISRO? It was launched in December 2019 along with nine foreign satellites on board PSLV-C48.
questions.x: RISAT-2BR1, a radar imaging earth observation satellite, was launched on PSLV-C48 with nine foreign satellites on 11 December 2019.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Researchers at ______ created the first-ever Indian Brain Atlas referred to as 'IBA 100' in October 2019.
o: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Delhi (AIIMS)
International Institute of Information Technology, Hyderabad (IIIT-H)
questions.x: IIIT Hyderabad researchers created the first Indian Brain Atlas (IBA 100) in 2019.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: In July 2019, 'Bhabha Kavach' was launched at the International Police Expo 2019 in New Delhi. Which of the following correctly describes this product?
o: Radiation protection suit worn by nuclear workers
Firefighter protective clothing also called as bunker gear
questions.x: Bhabha Kavach, made with BARC technology, was presented as India's lightest bullet-proof jacket.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following options means an irrational fear of being without your mobile phone or being unable to use your phone for some reason, such as the absence of a signal or running out of minutes or battery power?
questions.x: Nomophobia ('no-mobile-phone phobia') is the fear of being without one's mobile phone.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: Name the welfare scheme that comes under 'Elaborate Governance: Navaratnalu of YSRCP' and promises to build 25 lakh homes for the poor over a five-year duration.
questions.x: 'Pedalandariki Illu' (houses for all the poor), one of the Navaratnalu, promised 25 lakh houses in five years.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which of the following is NOT a prominent tribe of Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: Savaras, Gadabas and Konda Reddis live in Andhra Pradesh, whereas the Santhals belong mainly to Jharkhand, West Bengal and Odisha.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Name the freedom fighter who designed and handed over the tricolor (which later became the national flag) to Mohandas Karamchand Gandhi.
questions.x: Pingali Venkayya of Machilipatnam designed the flag and gave it to Gandhi at the 1921 Bezawada (Vijayawada) Congress meeting.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which of the following events is associated with the Congress working committee meeting in Vijayawada in 1921?
o: Allan Octavian Hume was present during the meeting.
A resolution demanding complete independence from the British government was passed.
Talks between MK Gandhi and Lord Irwin led to signing of the Gandhi-Irwin Pact.
MK Gandhi's leadership of the freedom movement was accepted.
questions.x: The key states that the 1921 Bezawada meeting endorsed Gandhi's leadership of the non-cooperation struggle; the other options belong to other events.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: 'Andhra Mahabharatam' is the Telugu version of 'Mahabharata' written by Kavitrayam, which means trinity of poets. From the given options, identify the poet who is NOT a part of this trinity.
questions.x: The Kavitrayam were Nannaya, Tikkana and Errana (Yerrapragada); Pampa was a Kannada poet.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which of the following hill stations is located in the Visakhapatnam district, at an elevation of more 3200 feet? It receives snowfall during the winter season in India.
questions.x: Lambasingi (about 1,000 m) in the Visakhapatnam Agency, called the 'Kashmir of Andhra', sometimes has sub-zero winter temperatures and frost.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In December 2019, the Andhra Pradesh Legislative Assembly passed a new bill called ______, which provides for awarding death sentence for offences of rape and gang rape and expediting verdict in trials of such cases within 21 days.
questions.x: The AP Disha Bill, 2019 provides the death penalty for rape and requires trials to finish within 21 days.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which of the following articles of the Constitution of India grants special provisions for Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: Article 371-D (added in 1973) makes special provisions for Andhra Pradesh in public employment and education.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Who was the second president of India? He is also a Bharat Ratna Award winner.
questions.x: Dr. Sarvepalli Radhakrishnan (President 1962-67) received the Bharat Ratna in 1954.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Name the comprehensive e-governance project launched in Andhra Pradesh to make for good governance and transparency in administration by judicious use of digital technologies.
questions.x: e-Pragati is Andhra Pradesh's state-wide e-governance programme.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which of the following is a Welfare scheme under which financial assistance will be provided to the farmers of Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: YSR Rythu Bharosa gives yearly investment support to farmers.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: What is the name of the innovative public private partnership launched by Andhra Pradesh government to promote youth employment?
questions.x: Rajiv Yuva Kiranalu was a public-private partnership for youth skilling and jobs in Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Who among the following belongs to the Yuvajana Shramika Raithu Congress Party (YSRCP)?
questions.x: Y. S. Jagan Mohan Reddy founded and leads the YSR Congress Party.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: In July 2019, Andhra Pradesh passed a law to reserve ______ of private sector jobs in the state for locals.
questions.x: The AP Employment of Local Candidates in Industries/Factories Act, 2019 reserves 75% of private jobs for locals.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: In December 2019, Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister Jagan Mohan Reddy hinted that the state may have a total of three capitals to keep up with the aspirations of the people. Which of the following cities was NOT a part of these three proposed names as capital?
questions.x: The three capitals proposed were Amaravati (legislative), Visakhapatnam (executive) and Kurnool (judicial), so Vijayawada was not one of them.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: What was the name of the awareness campaign launched in December 2019 by Chittoor Police in Andhra Pradesh for safety of women and children?
questions.x: Chittoor Police ran the 'Abhayam' campaign for the safety of women and children.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: In December 2019, Prakasam (Ongole) district police launched a pilot programme in Andhra Pradesh that offers to pick up and drop women who are stranded between 9 p.m. and 5 a.m. to their homes free of cost. What is the name of the pilot programme?
questions.x: Prakasam police's free night pick-up and drop service for women was called 'Abhay'.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which is India's first and oldest shipyard established way back in 1941 in Visakhapatnam? It has built vessels, repaired ships and is also known for conducting repairs for Indian Navy submarines.
questions.x: Hindustan Shipyard Limited (started in 1941 as Scindia Shipyard) is in Visakhapatnam.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which district is called 'The Rice Bowl' of Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: The fertile Godavari delta district of East Godavari is keyed as the 'Rice Bowl' of Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: As Andhra Pradesh is well known globally for its variety of rocks and minerals, it is called ______ of India.
questions.x: Because of its rich mineral wealth, Andhra Pradesh is called the 'Ratna Garbha' (womb of gems) of India.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: The Nagarjuna Sagar project, which was completed in 1960, is one of the largest irrigation projects. Name the river on which this project is built.
questions.x: Nagarjuna Sagar Dam is on the Krishna river.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Andhra Pradesh ranks first in India in the production of ______.
questions.x: Andhra Pradesh is India's top producer of fish and shrimp (aquaculture).
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Which of the following cities of Andhra Pradesh houses the Jawaharlal Nehru Auto Nagar Industrial Estate? It is the largest automobile industry hub of Asia.
questions.x: Jawaharlal Nehru Auto Nagar, one of Asia's largest auto hubs, is in Vijayawada.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: The state of Andhra Pradesh shares its borders with many other states. Which of the following states does NOT share its border with Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: Andhra Pradesh borders Telangana, Odisha, Chhattisgarh, Karnataka and Tamil Nadu, but not Kerala.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: The Southern portion of the state of Andhra Pradesh is identified as ______.
questions.x: The southern interior region of Andhra Pradesh is Rayalaseema.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which is the largest district of Andhra Pradesh in terms of area?
questions.x: Anantapur was the largest district of Andhra Pradesh by area.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Andhra Pradesh has the second longest coastline in India. Which of the following states has a coastline that is longer than that of Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: Gujarat has India's longest coastline (about 1,600 km), followed by Andhra Pradesh (about 974 km).
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is the highest mountain peak of Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: Arma Konda (about 1,680 m) in the Eastern Ghats of Visakhapatnam district is the highest peak in Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Nagarjuna-Srisailam Sanctuary of Andhra Pradesh is the largest tiger reserve of India by area. What is the new name of this reserve?
questions.x: The Nagarjunasagar-Srisailam Tiger Reserve was renamed the Rajiv Gandhi Wildlife Sanctuary in 1992.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: The longest river of South India is based in Andhra Pradesh. What is the name of this river?
questions.x: The Godavari (about 1,465 km) is the longest river in peninsular India and reaches the sea in Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is NOT a district in Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: Tumkur (Tumakuru) is a district of Karnataka.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is one of the largest freshwater lakes of India? It is situated between the Krishna and Godavari delta in Andhra Pradesh.
questions.x: Kolleru Lake lies between the Krishna and Godavari deltas.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Anantapur district in Andhra Pradesh houses 'Thimmamma Marrimanu', which was recorded in the Guinness Book of World Records in 1989. What is Thimmamma Marrimanu?
o: It is a temple with the most number of steps in the world.
It is the longest sari in the world that is made out of pure silk.
It is the largest Banyan tree in the world.
It is the biggest hall in the world without any pillars.
questions.x: Thimmamma Marrimanu is a giant banyan tree with the world's largest canopy (Guinness, 1989).
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: What is the name of the caves that are situated near Visakhapatnam and famous for million-year-old stalactite and stalagmite formation?
questions.x: The Borra Caves in the Ananthagiri hills near Visakhapatnam are known for their stalactites and stalagmites.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following cities is the closest to Koundinya Wildlife Sanctuary in Andhra Pradesh that is essentially an elephant reserve?
questions.x: Koundinya Wildlife Sanctuary, an elephant reserve, is in Chittoor district.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is the highest waterfall located in Nerabailu village of Andhra Pradesh? It is surrounded by dense forests and home to rare and endangered species of animals.
questions.x: Talakona, the highest waterfall in Andhra Pradesh, is near Nerabailu in Chittoor district.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: What is the name of the cyclonic storm that hit Andhra Pradesh in October 2018 and severely affected districts of Srikakulam and Vizianagaram?
questions.x: Cyclone Titli struck Srikakulam and Vizianagaram in October 2018.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In October 2014, Visakhapatnam or Vizag, the largest city in Andhra Pradesh, faced massive devastation caused by 'Cyclone Hudhud'. What is the meaning of the name 'Hudhud'?
o: It means hood of a big snake.
It is a Thai word for sapphire.
It is an Indian name for boys which means 'wind'
It is the name of a bird in the Quran
questions.x: Hudhud, the Arabic name of the hoopoe bird mentioned in the Quran, was a name proposed by Oman.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following cyclones occurred in Bay of Bengal and made landfall in the state of Andhra Pradesh in December 2018?
questions.x: Cyclone Phethai made landfall near Kakinada in December 2018.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In July 2017, a state-of-the-art lightning tracking application, which was developed in collaboration with ISRO, was launched for BSNL users. Users of the app get alerts from the Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Response Management Authority on the location of lightning at least 45 minutes in advance. What is the name of the app?
questions.x: 'Vajrapath' is the Andhra Pradesh app that warns users about lightning strikes in advance.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following systems was put in place by Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA) to initiate real-time satellite communication?
questions.x: APSDMA set up a Satellite Based Mobile Data Voice (SBMDV) terminal network for real-time satellite communication.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: What is the name of the mobile app that makes use of Automatic Weather Stations and Ground Water Piezometers, installed across the state of Andhra Pradesh as well as weather forecast data from ISRO to provide required weather parameters?
questions.x: The key gives 'Andhra Pradesh Varuna' as the state weather app built on AWS, piezometer and ISRO forecast data.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: If there is a heavy downpour with incessant rains and cyclonic conditions, which of the following will be issued by Andhra Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority?
questions.x: A 'red message' is the highest-level weather warning; a Red Corner Notice is an Interpol alert.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is a popular remote sensing method that uses light in the form of a pulsed laser to measure ranges (distances) to a target on Earth's surface?
questions.x: LiDAR measures distances with pulsed laser light.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: In Andhra Pradesh, a ______ is the real-time governance system that incorporates detailed disaster mitigation plans, integrates other real-time data and shows these on a single pane of glass that enables decision-making in a timely manner.
questions.x: The AP Real-Time Governance Society used the Hitachi Visualization Suite to bring data together on one screen.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: Which of the following technologies is used to forecast heavy rainfall and thunderstorms?
questions.x: Doppler weather radars track rain and storm movement and are used to forecast heavy rain and thunderstorms.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: In September 2018, Intergovernmental Oceanographic Commission (IOC) of UNESCO organised a two-day tsunami mock exercise (drill) for India and 23 other Indian Ocean Nations to enhance tsunami preparedness at community level. What was the name of the exercise?
questions.x: IOWave18 was the IOC-UNESCO Indian Ocean tsunami drill of September 2018.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: In February 2019, Andhra Pradesh stood fourth in the list of states of India in achieving national targets set for 13 of the 17 Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) by 2030. Which of the following states is ahead of Andhra Pradesh and in the Top 3 list?
questions.x: In the NITI Aayog SDG India Index 2018, Himachal Pradesh shared the top spot with Kerala, ahead of Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Which of the following is a target set by Andhra Pradesh to achieve by the year 2024?
o: To become India's first 100% zero budget natural farming state
To become the number one state in rice production in the country
To become a state with zero bad debts by farmers for loans issued to them
To become the first state in the country with 100% adoption of crop insurance by farmers
questions.x: Andhra Pradesh aimed to become India's first 100% Zero Budget Natural Farming state by 2024.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: How many Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) were adopted by India in September 2015 as a part of the resolution, "Transforming Our World: the 2030 Agenda for Sustainable Development"?
questions.x: The 2030 Agenda adopted in September 2015 has 17 SDGs.
questions.subject: General Studies

questions.s: At the Central Government level, which agency was assigned the role of overseeing the implementation of Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) in India?
o: Center for Environment and Sustainable Development India (CESDI)
The Comptroller and Auditor General of India (CAG)
questions.x: NITI Aayog oversees and coordinates SDG implementation in India.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Name the grassroots women's organisation in Andhra Pradesh which is among the 22 winners of the United Nations award 'Equator Prize 2019'.
questions.x: The key names the Deccan Development Society, a women's farming collective, among the 22 Equator Prize 2019 winners.
questions.subject: Current Affairs

questions.s: Which of the following steps was initiated by Andhra Pradesh government in September 2019 to keep a check on pollution by industrial houses?
o: Requiring such companies to plant 10,000 trees
Imposing and collecting green tax from such companies
Increasing the penalty to Rs 20 lakhs if action is not taken as per notice
Disallowing further production activities in the plant with immediate effect
questions.x: In September 2019 Andhra Pradesh decided to levy a green tax on polluting industries.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: ______ are losing their lives due to mechanised boats and big nets used by fishermen for fishing in Andhra Pradesh and Odisha.
questions.x: Olive Ridley turtles nesting on the Andhra and Odisha coasts are often killed in trawler nets.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: As per the new sand policy of September 2019, which agency has been tasked with operating stockyards in Andhra Pradesh?
questions.x: Under the 2019 sand policy, APMDC runs the sand reaches and stockyards.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: As per the analysis of water quality by Andhra Pradesh Pollution Control Board (APPCB), the quality of water in all major rivers in Andhra Pradesh falls under ______ category.
questions.x: APPCB placed the water of the major rivers in CPCB designated-use Class C (drinking water source after conventional treatment).
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Which of the following is a first-of-its-kind youth interaction programme in Andhra Pradesh to create awareness on air pollution?
questions.x: The key names 'Eco Air' as the youth awareness programme on air pollution.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which of the following institutions was formed by the Andhra Pradesh government to provide an effective mechanism for collection, transportation, storage, treatment, processing, delivery and disposal of industrial and other waste?
o: Environment Protection Training and Research Institute (EPTRI)
questions.x: The AP Environment Management Corporation was set up in 2019 to manage industrial and other waste.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which of the following findings in analysis of river water indicates mixing of human faeces?
o: Higher count of total coliform bacteria
questions.x: Coliform bacteria live in the human gut, so a high coliform count shows faecal contamination.
questions.subject: Science & Technology

questions.s: In December 2019, the officials of the Agriculture Department suggested to Kakinada farmers that they stop cultivating ______ variety of paddy as it is now being cultivated in Kerala. The state used to earlier buy this rice from Andhra Pradesh, but the demand for it has plummeted.
questions.x: Kerala used to buy the 'Bondalu' paddy from East Godavari, but demand fell once Kerala started growing it.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Name the project whose site in Chittoor district 'Mandaram Resource Centre' (MRC) includes a demonstration centre for alternative agriculture and sustainability practices and the volunteers work with local people and farmers, address local sustainability issues with solutions tailored to local conditions.
questions.x: The Mandaram Resource Centre in Chittoor district is the site of the 'Toranam' sustainability project.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Which port in Andhra Pradesh received the 'Golden Peacock Environment Management Award' in the year 2015 for its initiatives and achievements in the field of environment?
questions.x: Krishnapatnam Port won the Golden Peacock Environment Management Award in 2015.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: What is the name of the reserve in Andhra Pradesh that is part of the 'Project Elephant' scheme? It is shared by the state and the centre.
questions.x: Rayala Elephant Reserve in Chittoor is Andhra Pradesh's Project Elephant reserve; the others are in Kerala and Tamil Nadu.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: The Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014 is an Act of Indian Parliament that bifurcated the state of Andhra Pradesh into Telangana and the residuary Andhra Pradesh state. What is this act popularly known as?
questions.x: The AP Reorganisation Act, 2014 is popularly called the Telangana Act.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: As per the Andhra Pradesh Reorganisation Act, 2014, ______ became the capital of the newly formed state of Telangana, after the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh. The city will remain as the joint capital of both states for a period of time not exceeding ten years.
questions.x: Hyderabad became Telangana's capital and the common capital of both states for up to 10 years.
questions.subject: Polity

questions.s: Which of the following political parties was founded by actor and politician Pawan Kalyan and came up around the period closer to when the state of Andhra Pradesh got bifurcated?
questions.x: Pawan Kalyan founded the Jana Sena Party in March 2014.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: For which of the following projects in Andhra Pradesh did the Telangana government approach the Supreme Court to put the work on hold and appealed to first review the environmental impact assessment (EIA) of the project?
questions.x: Telangana (like Odisha and Chhattisgarh) went to the Supreme Court over the submergence and environmental impact of the Polavaram project.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: After the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh, the political regimes of Telangana and Andhra Pradesh fought tooth and nail for the monopoly of which of the following rivers?
questions.x: After bifurcation, the two states have fought over sharing the waters of the Krishna and Godavari.
questions.subject: Geography

questions.s: Quoting the issue of revenue deficit after the bifurcation of Andhra Pradesh, what major demand did the then Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu place before the Government of India?
o: To declare President's rule in the state of Andhra Pradesh
To permanently keep Hyderabad as the common capital for both the states of Andhra Pradesh as well as Telangana
To grant special category status to the state of Andhra Pradesh
To reverse the decision and combine the states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana again
questions.x: Citing the revenue deficit, Chandrababu Naidu demanded special category status for Andhra Pradesh.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Hyderabad had become a bone of contention during the bifurcation of the states of Andhra Pradesh and Telangana. What was the major reason for this?
o: The majority of power generation of the undivided state happened in Hyderabad alone
The majority of the state income to the tune of 70% was concentrated in Hyderabad alone
Hyderabad always got the major share of the water of Krishna and Godavari rivers
The Telugu speaking population percentage-wise was concentrated more in Hyderabad and its immediate proximity only
questions.x: Hyderabad produced a very large share of the undivided state's revenue, which the key puts at about 70%, so both states wanted it.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: Four years after bifurcation, the residual state of Andhra Pradesh announced its state symbols and adopted ______ as the state flower.
questions.x: In 2018 Andhra Pradesh adopted jasmine (Malle) as its state flower.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: During his regime, Chandrababu Naidu, the first CM of the residual state of Andhra Pradesh, held a week-long programme or a pledge to rebuild a new state all over the state, where he made people take a vow to build a new and developed Andhra Pradesh. What was the name of the programme?
questions.x: 'Nava Nirmana Deeksha' was the week-long pledge programme held every June from 2015.
questions.subject: AP History & Culture

questions.s: ______ is one of the key initiatives undertaken by the residual state of Andhra Pradesh which is believed to attract investment of close to $17 billion, and will create 20,000 jobs.
o: Construction of Amaravati as State Capital
questions.x: The ADB-backed Visakhapatnam-Chennai Industrial Corridor was expected to bring large investment and jobs.
questions.subject: Economy

questions.s: Name the person who succeeded Narasimhan as the Governor of the residual state of Andhra Pradesh after the bifurcation.
questions.x: Biswa Bhusan Harichandan succeeded E. S. L. Narasimhan as Governor of Andhra Pradesh in July 2019.
questions.subject: Polity
